# Code Anchors: Checkout-Only Path Gate

- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.ts` — the scanner and its classifier, now also the repository-template-folder read check, the unshipped lookup-name check, and the one build-time assertion that names every finding.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-master-reads.spec.ts` — the gate itself, run over the live authored payload, plus unit coverage for the exemption, a fallback, a plain read, an earlier-sentence negation, and the body/line reporting.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-components.ts` — enumerates the shipped bodies the scan walks.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the body whose fallback this gate replaced.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the body that names the guarded location only to rule it out, and so must stay exempt.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/template-lookup.ts` — supplies the guarded checkout location and the release template set the lookup-name check compares against.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/pack-release.ts` — runs the assertion before the release build clears its output, so a breaking payload stops the build.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-template-stages.spec.ts` — the gate run over the live payload: no repository template read, no unshipped lookup name.
